name: Subscription page loads with current plan
steps: Verify billing page loads showing current plan and available plans
expected: Subscription page loads showing current plan, credit balance, and upgrade/downgrade options

name: Upgrade from Free to Starter plan
steps: Complete Stripe checkout with test card (4242 4242 4242 4242)
expected: Stripe checkout completes, plan updates to the selected tier, credits balance increases by the new plan allocation. Note: Requires active Stripe webhook (stripe listen --forward-to)

name: Downgrade plan (scheduled for period end)
steps: Click downgrade to a lower plan
Check that current plan stays active until period end
expected: Downgrade scheduled for end of billing period, current plan remains active, UI shows pending downgrade

name: Cancel subscription
steps: Verify cancellation is scheduled for period end
expected: Cancellation scheduled for period end, credits preserved, UI shows pending cancellation

name: Billing portal accessible
steps: Click 'Manage billing' or billing portal link
expected: Stripe billing portal opens showing payment methods, invoices, and subscription details

name: Credit balance displays correctly
steps: Check credit balance in the UI (dashboard or subscription page)
Compare with MongoDB customers collection credits field
expected: UI credit balance matches the database value for credits

name: Monthly/Yearly toggle behavior
steps: Check if Monthly/Yearly toggle is available
If on paid plan: verify toggle is locked to current interval
If on free plan: verify both intervals are selectable
expected: Monthly/Yearly toggle locked for paid subscribers (can't change interval mid-subscription), available for free users

name: All billing endpoints require authentication
steps: Call billing API endpoints without auth cookie:
expected: All endpoints return 401 Unauthorized when called without authentication
